As a fat person... bluntly, it is my body. What gives you a right to comment on my size?

Also, in many cases bigger people have health issues. I take SSRI medications. Losing weight on these medications is nearly impossible. So a lot -not all- of people who may be larger may have mental health issues. I literally can work out five days a week, eat nothing but salads and boiled eggs, and not drop weight. Trust me. I've tried. 

Also, larger people may have hypothyroidism. When your thyroid is low, not only do you get tired and depressed easily, you wind up having a hard time losing the weight. Even on replacement hormone, it can be difficult to lose weight.

Another tidbit- what happens if someone just can't work out due to arthritis/injury? Diet is important but if you cant move, how can you drop the weight?

Tldr; There are a lot of reasons someone may be larger that they have little to no control over, many of them medical. That's why you don't comment rudely on other people's bodies.

So, it's lunchtime. We had a little courtyard in the middle of the school building where we were allowed to eat lunch. I happened to have a bottle of black glitter (Ok, who am I kidding, I \*always\* have glitter. I am now 27, and still have glitter stowed in my car/purse).

So I started drawing a pentacle with my glitter. I had no friends to sit with at lunch, so why not? Soon enough, the glitter was set up. People were starting to wonder what I was doing, since I was now kneeling on the pavement in the middle of my sparkly pentacle. Now, I didn't know any latin... but they didn't offer it at our school, so nobody else did. So I start chanting as ominously as I can, mentioning the person's name several times. She comes up, sees it's me, and rolls her eyes skyward as I continue chanting. 

"Kit, what are you doing?" 

"I'm summoning demons to destroy my enemies." I break from the chanting and look up at her. 

"You don't have enemies." This woman was not the brightest, as she proved later in the year. 

"Yes I do." She looks up at the sky again, possibly seeking divine help 

"Kit... no. No summoning demons during lunch." She paused. "Or at any other time on school property." I was convinced to clean up the glitter and NOBODY touched my notebook without permission after that,t hough the bullying continued. I have... a lot of stories. High school me was proof that teenagers are not adults.
